goal: Alert maintainers when the Windows code signing certificate is expiring or expired
Prevents expedited or point releases from being delayed by an unexpected expired certificate
agreement: Strong support for automated monitoring over manual release checks (fanquake)
Emphasizes certificates must always work for expedited and point releases (fanquake)
Open suggestion to make the check script standalone so it can run locally (maflcko)

categories.name: build
why: P3 because it automates certificate monitoring to avoid surprise release blockers
Replaces manual tracking with weekly alerts so keys are always ready for urgent releases
Provides clear operational value for maintainers while remaining reasonably deferrable
